verdict.rationale: Datalab documents explicit processing limits and tells users to split larger documents with the page_range parameter, so the product's own answer to oversized files is manual chunking rather than native handling. Async completion webhooks reduce polling, but nothing shows thousand-page or multi-gigabyte files completing reliably. missing for 10: native handling of thousand-page and multi-gigabyte files without manual segmentation, the actual page and file-size limits, documented timeout behavior, guarantees against silent truncation, independent or hands-on corroboration on very large files.

support.subject: As a data engineer, thousand-page documents and multi-gigabyte files process reliably without timeouts or silent truncation

citations.quote: For documents exceeding these limits, use the page_range parameter to process in segments
Webhooks provide real-time notifications when your document processing jobs complete, eliminating the need for continuous polling.
